definitions.explanation: A flat horizontal surface attached to a wall or in a frame, used for storing or displaying things.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{棚|たな}に{置|お}いてください。
examples.english: Please put the book on the shelf.

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}から{物|もの}が{落|お}ちた。
{新|あたら}しい{本棚|ほんだな}を{買|か}いました。

notes:
{棚|たな} refers to any shelf or rack.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {本棚|ほんだな}: bookshelf
- {食器棚|しょっきだな}: cupboard, dish cabinet
- {戸棚|とだな}: cupboard, cabinet (with doors)
- {神棚|かみだな}: household Shinto altar shelf

IDIOMS:
- {棚|たな}に{上|あ}げる: to shelve (an issue), to set aside
- {棚|たな}からぼた{餅|もち}: unexpected good fortune (lit. rice cake falling from shelf)
